text.body: <1> ākāśavāyuprabhavaḥ śarīrātsamuccaran vaktramupaiti nādaḥ | sthānāntareṣu pravibhajyamāno varṇatvamāgacchati yaḥ sa śabdaḥ || 1 || tamakṣaraṃ brahma paraṃ pavitraṃ guhāśayaṃ samyaguśanti viprāḥ | 2 || sthānamidaṃ karaṇamidaṃ prayatna eṣa dvidhānilaḥ sthānaṃ pīḍayati vṛttikāraḥ prakrama eṣo'tha nābhitalāt || 3 || tatra sthānakaraṇaprayatnebhyo varṇāstriṣaṣṭiḥ | 4 || tatra varṇānāṃ keṣāṃ kiṃ sthānaṃ kiṃ kāraṇaṃ prayatnaśca kaḥ keṣāmityucyate | 5 || <2> sthānaprakaraṇam tatra sthānaṃ tāvat | 1 | akuhavisarjanīyāḥ kaṇṭhyāḥ | 2 | havisarjanīyāvurasyāvekeṣām | 3 | jihvāmūlīyo jihvyaḥ | 4 | kavargāvarṇānusvārajihvāmūlīyā jihvyā ekeṣām | 5 | sarvamukhasthānamavarṇameke | 6 | icuyaśāstālavyāḥ | 7 | ṛṭuraṣā mūrdhanyāḥ | 8 | ro dantamūlasthānamekeṣām | 9 | ḷtulasā dantyāḥ | 10 | vakāro dantoṣṭhyaḥ | 11 | sṛkvasthānameke | 12 | upūpadhmānīyā oṣṭhyāḥ | 13 | anusvārayamā nāsikyāḥ | 14 | kaṇṭhanāsikyamanusvārameke | 15 | yamāśca nāsikyajihvāmūlīyā ekeṣām | 16 | edaitau kaṇṭhatālavyau | 17 | odautau kaṇṭhoṣṭhyau | 18 | ñamaṅaṇanā svasthānā nāsikasthānāśca | 19 | dvivarṇāṇi sandhyakṣarāṇi | 20 | sarepha ṛvarṇaḥ | 21 | <3> karaṇaprakaraṇam karaṇamapi | 1 | jihvyatālavyamūrdhanyadantyānāṃ jihvā karaṇam | 2 | kathamiti | 3 | jihvāmūlena jihvyānām | 4 | jihvāmadhyena tālavyānām | 5 | jihvopāgreṇa mūrdhanyānām | 6 | jihvāgrādhaḥ karaṇaṃ vā | 7 | jihvāgreṇa dantyānām | 8 | śeṣāḥ svasthānakaraṇāḥ | 9 | ityetat karaṇam | 10 | <4> antaḥprayatnaprakaraṇam prayatno dvividhaḥ | 1 | ābhyantaro bāhyaśca | 2 | ābhyantarastāvat | 3 | spṛṣṭakaraṇāḥ sparśāḥ | 4 | īṣatspṛṣṭakaraṇāḥ antasthāḥ | 5 | īṣadvivṛtakaraṇā ūṣmāṇaḥ | 6 | vivṛtakaraṇāḥ svarāḥ | 7 | tebhya e o vivṛtatarau | 8 | tābhyāmai au | 9 | tābhyāmapyākāraḥ | 10 | saṃvṛto'kāraḥ | 11 | ityeṣo'ntaḥprayatnaḥ | 12 | <5> bāhyaprayatnaprakaraṇam atha bāhyaḥ | 1 | vargāṇāṃ prathamadvitīyāḥ śaṣasavisarjanīyajihvāmūlīyopadhmānīyā yamau ca |3| prathamadvitīyau vivṛtakaṇṭhāḥ śvāsānupradānā aghoṣāḥ | 4 | vargayamānāṃ prathame'lpaprāṇā itare sarve mahāprāṇāḥ | 5 | vargāṇāṃ tṛtīyacaturthā antasthā hakārānusvārau yamau ca tṛtīyacaturthau saṃvṛtakaṇṭhā nādānupradānā ghoṣavantaḥ | 6 | vargayamānāṃ tṛtīyā antasthāścalpaprāṇā itare sarve mahāprāṇāḥ | 7 | yathā tṛtīyāstathā pañcamāḥ | 8 | ānunāsikyameṣāmadhiko guṇaḥ | 9 | kādayo māvasānāḥ sparśāḥ | 10 | yādayo'ntasthāḥ | 11 | śādaya ūṣmāṇaḥ | 12 | sasthānena dvitīyāḥ | 13 | hakāreṇa caturthāḥ | 14 | eṣa bāhya prayatnaḥ | 15 | <6> sthānapīḍaprakaraṇam tatra sparśayamavarṇakāro vāyurayaḥpiṇḍavatsthānamabhipīḍayati | 1 | antasthavarṇakāro vāyurdārupiṇḍavat | 2 | ūṣmasvaravarṇakāro vāyurūrṇāpiṇḍavat | 3 | <7> vṛttikāraprakaraṇam evaṃ vyākhyāne vṛttikārā paṭhanti -- aṣṭādaśaprabhedamavarṇakulamiti | atra | 1 | hrasvadīrghaplutatvācca traisvaryopanayena ca | ānunāsikyabhedācca saṅkhyāto'ṣṭādaśātmakaḥ || iti || | 2 | evavirṇādayaḥ | 3 | ḷvarṇasya dīrghā na santi | 4 | taṃ dvādaśaprabhedamācakṣate | 5 | yadṛcchāśaktijānukaraṇā vā yadā dīrghāḥ syustadā tamapyaṣṭādaśaprabhedaṃ bruvate | 6 | sandhyakṣarāṇāṃ hrasvā na santi | 7 | tānyapi dvādaśaprabhedāni | 8 | chandogānāṃ sātyamugrirāṇāyanīyā hrasvāni paṭhanti | 9 | teṣāmapyaṣṭādaśaprabhedāni | 10 | antasthā dviprabhedā rephavarjitāḥ sānunāsikā niranunāsikāśca | 11 | rephoṣmaṇāṃ savarṇā na santi | 12| vargyo vargyeṇa savarṇaḥ | 13 | <8> prakramaprakaraṇam eṣa kramo varṇānām | 1 | tatraiṣāṃ sthānakaraṇaprayatnānāṃ vyākaraṇaprasiddharucyate | 2 | iha yatra sthāne varṇā upalabhyante tatsthānam | 3 | yena nivartyante tatkaraṇam | 4 | prayatanaṃ prayatnaḥ | 5 | <9> nābhitalaprakaraṇam tatra nābhipradeśātpreritaḥ prāṇo nāma vāyurūrdhvamākrāmannuraḥprabhṛtīnāṃ sthānānāmanyatamasminsthāne prayatnena vidhāryate | sa vidhāryamāṇo vāyuḥ sthānamabhihanti | tasmātsthānābhighātād dhvanirutpadyata ākāśe | sā varṇaśrutiḥ | sa varṇasyātmalābhaḥ | 1 | tatra dhvanāvutpadyamāne yadā sthānakaraṇaprayatnāḥ parasparaṃ spṛśanti sā spṛṣṭatā | 2 | yadeṣatspṛśanti tadeṣatspṛṣṭatā | 3 | dūreṇa yadā spṛśanti sā vivṛtatā | 4 | sāmīpyena yadā spṛśanti sā saṃvṛtatā | 5 | ityeṣa'ntaḥprayatnaḥ | 6 | sa idānīṃ prāṇo nāma vāyurūrdhvamākrāmanmūdhni pratihato nivṛtto yadā koṣṭhamabhihanti tadā koṣṭheṣabhihanyamāne galabilasya vivṛtatvādvivāraḥ saṃvṛtatvātsaṃvāro jāyate | 7 | tau saṃvāravivārau | 8 | tatra yadā kaṇṭhabilaṃ saṃvṛtaṃ bhavati tadā nādo jāyate | 9 | vivṛte kaṇṭhabile śvāso jāyate | 10 | tau śvāsanādāvanupradānamityācakṣate | 11 | anye tu bruvate -- anupradānamanusvāno ghaṇṭānirhradavat | 12 | tatra yadā sthānābhighātaje dhvanau nādo'nupradīyate tadā nādadhvanisaṃsargād ghoṣo jāyate | 13 | yadā śvāso'nupradīyate tadā śvāsadhvanisaṃsargādaghoṣaḥ | 14 | sā ghoṣavadaghoṣatā | 15 | mahati vāyau mahāprāṇaḥ | 16 | alpe vāyāvalpaprāṇaḥ | 17 | sālpaprāṇamahāprāṇatā | 18 | mahāprāṇatvādūṣmatvam | 19 | yadā sarvāṅgānusārī prayatnastīvro bhavati tadā gātrasya nigrahaḥ kaṇṭhabilasya | 20 | āṇutvaṃ svarasya ca vāyostīvragatitvādraukṣyaṃ bhavati | tamudāttamācakṣate | 21 | yadā tu mandaḥ prayatno bhavati tadā gātrasya sraṃsanaṃ kaṇṭhabilasya mahattvaṃ svarasya ca vāyormandagatitvatsnigdhatā bhavati | tamanudāttamācakṣate | 22 | udāttānudāttasvarasannipātātsvarita iti | 23 | evaṃ prayatno'bhinirvṛttaḥ kṛtsnaḥ prayatno bhavati | 24 | aṣṭau sthānāni varṇānāmuraḥ kaṇṭhaḥ śirastathā | jihvāmūlaṃ ca dantāśca nāsikoṣṭhau ca tālu ca || 25 | spṛṣṭatvamīṣatspṛṣṭatvaṃ saṃvṛtatvaṃ tathaiva ca | vivṛtatvaṃ ca varṇānāmantaḥkaraṇamucyate || 26 | kālo vivārasaṃvārau śvāsanādāvaghoṣatā | ghoṣo'lpaprāṇatā caiva mahāprāṇaḥ svarāstrayaḥ || 27 |
